linux_pty_note: Earlier A75 full suite encountered 6 reopen failures due to retained TIOCEXCL on Linux PTYs; reproduced independently. Live USB serial startup and reopen checks passed.
hardware_scope: A73 startup and timed B/C registration, disabled at end; camera/model warmup and full A sweep covered by software regression only in this release.
power_switch_observation: One operator power switch attempt preserved command count2 and zero flags; no MCU reset signature. ST-Link explicit reset subsequently produced a fresh boot. USB power source not established.
